text:
A Frost Advisory is up for Burlington from 2 to 9 Wednesday morning, so protect anything tender before bed. The day has played out as advertised, early clouds gave way to a clear, cool afternoon, and we’re sitting right around 63 with a north wind around 8 mph. That breeze fades tonight under clear skies, with temperatures dropping toward 43 and a chance of patchy frost before sunrise. The lake is quieting too, with waves around 1 to 2 feet this evening.

Wednesday looks like the better outdoor day, sunny and a touch warmer near 67, with light north winds and waves a foot or less. Plan on a chilly start, then comfortable sunshine by late morning. Bring plants in tonight, and if you’re heading to the waterfront this evening, the light breeze and calm water favor an easy outing, but grab a layer for the ride home.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Happy Tuesday! It was cool again this morning with most places starting off in the 30s to lower 40s. We do have a bit more in terms of morning cloud cover to start the day, but we should lose that and pick up more sunshine by the time we head into this afternoon. Temperatures start to turn a bit warmer, as we head back into the low and mid-60s come this afternoon. Clear skies tonight will set us up for another cool and potentially frosty start to Wednesday. Most of us will see overnight lows that fall into the 30s and lower 40s to start Wednesday.
